A role is a system prompt that shapes how the assistant answers. Tap a role to make it active, long-press a custom role to edit or delete it.

Enable debug mode in Mintgram Settings > About to create a heap dump on every future OOM.

**NEVER** share the resulting .hprof file with anyone — it is a snapshot of the app's memory and **contains sensitive information** (messages, tokens, etc.).
